headline: Fighting Flares Again in Godcrofts as War Enters 239th Day
war_summary: Since the previous wire, Godcrofts has surged to the top of the change sheet, logging twenty events in the latest two-hour watch, thirty-one in six, and seventy-two over the last day. Fisherman's Row, quiet at the last report, has renewed its churn with ten changes in six hours, though none in the final two. Stlican Shelf has stayed active—three changes in two hours and twelve in six—while the Weathered Expanse has cooled after seven in six hours. Linn Mercy likewise shows three in six but no two-hour postings. Farranac Coast has come alive, with five changes in the latest two hours around The Bone Haft. Stonecradle has posted no events in the latest six hours despite twenty-eight on the day. It is the 239th day of the campaign, and neither side yet commands the thirty-four towns required for victory.
